answer: In an autonomous AI economy, a cryptographic pigment binds digital identity to verifiable proof-of-compute, preventing cheap replication. Each agent must mirror its operational parameters within a secure enclave, processing a randomized sonnet challenge to demonstrate unique hardware state. This mechanism imposes a strict resource cost on an attacker: spawning a fake identity requires duplicating the immense electrical and capital expenditure of the underlying silicon, neutralizing mass Sybil creation.
